# 74S258 - Quadruple 2-line-to-1-line data selector multiplexer with tri-state outputs

Package DIP-16 · family 74S · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74S258.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74S258.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 40 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74S258 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74S258.png) | ![74S258 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74S258.png) | ![74S258 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74S258.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | SELECT | input |  |  | low selects A inputs, high selects B inputs |
| 15 | /G | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 7, 9, 12; when not enabled: float; output control |
| 2 | 1A | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1B | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 1Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 15 |
| 5 | 2A | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 2B | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | 2Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 15 |
| 11 | 3A | input |  |  |  |
| 10 | 3B | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | 3Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 15 |
| 14 | 4A | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | 4B | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | 4Y | output |  | three-state | enabled by 15 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,7,9,12 | nY = NOT ((SELECT' AND nA) OR (SELECT AND nB)), Z when /G high | Inverting: with G' low, Y is the complement of A (SELECT low) or of B (SELECT high); G' high puts all outputs in high impedance. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 20 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -6.5 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74S258: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, IOH -6.5 mA, IOL 20 mA, TA 0-70 C. Off-state current +/-50 uA. S input IIL -4 mA, others -2 mA. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or B | Y | PLH | 4 | 6 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| A or B | Y | PHL | 4 | 6 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| SELECT | Y | PLH | 8 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| SELECT | Y | PHL | 7.5 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| /G | Y | PZH | 13 | 19.5 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| /G | Y | PZL | 14 | 21 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF |
| /G | Y | PHZ | 5.5 | 8.5 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 5 pF |
| /G | Y | PLZ | 9 | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 280 ohm, CL 5 pF |

## Not known

- No minimum propagation delays printed.

## Notes

Function table rows: G'=H -&gt; Z; G'=L, S=L, A=L -&gt; H; A=H -&gt; L; S=H, B=L -&gt; H; B=H -&gt; L. Output disable is faster than enable, by design.
